field.name: TrackerPort.readSignoffRequest
field.type: (ref: SignoffRequestRef) => PortResult<{ branch: string; open: boolean }>
field.purpose: A resubmission has to decide between pushing to an existing request and opening a new one. readSignoffState maps a closed request and one with changes requested to the same state, so the port needs to say which branch the request was opened from and whether it is still open. A tracker without it is treated as unable to revise: the submission opens a new request as in s7.

body.rationale: Additive and optional on the port. Without it an open pull request that was asked for changes cannot be told from a closed one, so a revision would either fail on a second 'gh pr create' or strand the old thread.
